name: Merge without a master CI verdict past its repository's master-cycle threshold
description: Fires when any repository's oldest merge without a default-branch CI verdict is older than that repository's threshold: MAX(awaiting.over_threshold_minutes) > 0 over merged-green.awaiting events, by repo. The emitter computes awaiting.threshold_minutes = min(max(60, 2 x ci.master_cycle_p50_minutes + 30), 180), because steady-state verdict latency is up to about two master cycles, and caps it at 180 so a stall that inflates its own cycle p50 still fires. On 2026-11-14 the oldest such merge reached 241 min unalarmed (CI-stall retro, guard G1). Emitter: the merged-green reconciler (livespec-dev-tooling-gaetnq); until it converges, ~/.local/share/pr-throughput/emit.py on hetzner-xubuntu (plan throughput-metric). Receiver: Honeycomb events API, dataset pr-throughput. Item: livespec-dev-tooling-754wgi. Runbook: open the repo's default-branch Actions runs; a queued or missing CI run means runner capacity (Kueue, ARC listener). A silent emitter is the merged-green.pass dead-man's job.
